question: World TB Day is celebrated on which date?
solution:
The correct answer is __24 March__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• World TB Day is celebrated every year on 24 March annually to commemorate the date when Dr. Robert Koch announced his discovery of Mycobacterium tuberculosis, the bacillus that causes TB in 1882.
 
• This Day is observed to educate people about TB, its impact around the world.
 
• The theme of World TB Day 2022 - 'Invest to End TB. Save Lives.'
